"""snapshot: save canonical text of every ranking.c unit. eval LABEL: compile changed units."""
import sys, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import api, fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project

mode = sys.argv[1]
snap = Path(sys.argv[2])
p = Project('GFZE01')
TUS = ('rel/main_rel/bitmap.c', 'rel/main_rel/font.c', 'rel/main_rel/ranking.c')
units = [u for u in p.load_units() if u.get('tu') in TUS]
texts = {}
for u in units:
    texts[u['symbols'][0]] = api._canonical_text(p, u['source'])
if mode == 'snapshot':
    snap.write_text(json.dumps(texts))
    print(len(texts), 'units')
    raise SystemExit
before = json.loads(snap.read_text())
label = sys.argv[3]
out = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/bitmap-resource') / label
e = fixup.Engine(p, out)
rows = []
for name, text in texts.items():
    if before.get(name) == text:
        continue
    key = 'main_rel:' + name
    mw, flags = oracle.version_for(p, p.resolve(key))
    rows.append(e.record(key, text, mw, flags, label=label, before_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before[name].encode()).hexdigest()))
with oracle.build_lock():
    e.evaluate(rows)
report = dict(hypothesis='Shared BitmapResource layout for lbl_1_data_FCD4[188]; installed-form compile of every changed bitmap.c/font.c/ranking.c unit.',
              stopping_condition='fixed loop/prototype variants once', records=rows, best={},
              frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows}, generator_sha256=e.generator_sha256, environment=e.environment)
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
fixup.archive_sources(report, out / 'sources.json.gz')
for r in rows:
    print(r['symbol'], r['sha256'][:12], bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors'), r.get('extra_helpers'))

bitmap_manifest.py.text:
"""archive | manifest for the BitmapResource batch (worktree root)."""
import sys, json, gzip, hashlib, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import fixup

stage, S = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
R = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/bitmap-resource')
DIRS = [R / 'final', R / 'fn_1_527B4']
ARCH = Path('state/repairs/bitmap-resource-layout-20261116.sources.json.gz')

if stage == 'archive':
    reps = [json.loads((d / 'report.json').read_text()) for d in DIRS]
    assert len({r['generator_sha256'] for r in reps}) == 1 and len({r['environment'] for r in reps}) == 1
    rows = [x for r in reps for x in r['records']]
    fixup.archive_sources(dict(records=rows, best={}, frontier={'all': rows}, generator_sha256=reps[0]['generator_sha256'],
                               environment=reps[0]['environment']), ARCH)
    print(len(json.loads(gzip.decompress(ARCH.read_bytes()))['records']))
    raise SystemExit

def multiset(rows):
    return sorted((r['symbol'], r['sha256'], r['mw'], r['flags'], bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors')) for r in rows)
arch = json.loads(gzip.decompress(ARCH.read_bytes()))
rep = json.loads(Path(f'.fzgx/fixup/replay/{ARCH.name}/replay.json').read_text())
assert rep['reproduced'] == len(arch['records']) and multiset(arch['records']) == multiset(rep['records'])
prof = {(r['symbol'], r['sha256']): r['compile_profile'] for r in arch['records']}
assert all(prof[(r['symbol'], r['sha256'])] == r['compile_profile'] for r in rep['records'])
log = (R / 'full-gates.log').read_bytes()
text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', log.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
returns = re.findall(r'^RETURN (\d+)$', text, re.M)
assert returns == ['0'] * 4 and text.count('16 files OK') >= 2 and '0 finding(s)' in text
census_path = Path('state/repairs/device-census-bitmap-resource-20261116.json.gz')
census = json.loads(gzip.decompress(census_path.read_bytes()))
summ = lambda rows: [dict(symbol=x['symbol'], label=x['label'], sha256=x['sha256'], mw=x['mw'], flags=x['flags'],
                          matched=bool(x.get('matched')), word_errors=x.get('word_errors')) for x in rows]
cohorts = {}
for d in [R / 'typed', R / 'min527', R / 'fn_1_527B4', R / 'final']:
    r = json.loads((d / 'report.json').read_text())
    cohorts[d.name] = dict(hypothesis=r['hypothesis'], stopping_condition=r['stopping_condition'], records=summ(r['records']))
final = json.loads((R / 'final/report.json').read_text())['records']
head = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
scripts = {n: dict(sha256=sha((S / n).read_bytes()), text=(S / n).read_text())
           for n in ('bitmap_apply.py', 'bitmap_eval.py', 'bitmap_527.py', 'bitmap_manifest.py')}
manifest = dict(
    format='fzgx-device-cleanup-provenance-v1', version='GFZE01', base_commit=head,
    source_tree_sha256=census['source_tree_sha256'], configuration_sha256=census['configuration_sha256'],
    headers={h: sha(Path(h).read_bytes()) for h in ('include/rel/main_rel/bitmap_resource.h', 'include/rel/main_rel/bitmap.h',
                                                    'include/rel/main_rel/font.h', 'include/rel/main_rel/ranking.h')},
    sources={s_: sha(Path(s_).read_bytes()) for s_ in ('src/rel/main_rel/bitmap.c', 'src/rel/main_rel/font.c', 'src/rel/main_rel/ranking.c')},
    evidence=dict(
        table='lbl_1_data_FCD4 is 0x1D60 = 188 x 0x28; retail data words 1..7 of each record relocate to archive path strings selected by lbl_801A66B4.',
        loader='fn_1_47AD4 stores the heap index (lbl_1_data_6CA0 entry), sets loaded=1 and the image set: count, 0x10-byte headers, GXInitTexObj objects of 0x20 bytes.',
        consumers='Twenty functions in bitmap.c, font.c and ranking.c accessed the same fields through private views or byte strides.'),
    cohorts=cohorts, scripts=scripts,
    replay_archive=dict(path=ARCH.name, sha256=sha(ARCH.read_bytes()), records=len(arch['records']), replayed=rep['reproduced'],
                        command='python tools/fzgx.py fixup --archive state/repairs/' + ARCH.name),
    accepted=[dict(function='main_rel:' + x['symbol'], sha256=x['sha256'], matched=bool(x.get('matched'))) for x in final],
    data_import_regeneration=json.loads((S / 'bitmap_regen.json').read_text()),
    limits='fn_1_47AD4 (the loader) keeps its own argument view; its body is a dense lifted reconstruction outside this batch. '
           'Only fields used by the consumers are named. The table data stays retail-linked. No device or natural-function credit.',
    removed=dict(private_type_definitions=12, private_views=11, generated_aggregate_views=3, scalar_carriers=0, tagged_register_copy_blocks=0),
    partial_cleanups_only=True, new_fully_natural_function_credit=0, fully_natural_function_credit_claimed=False,
    census=dict(path=census_path.name, sha256=sha(census_path.read_bytes()), categories=census['categories'],
                known_scaffolding_owner_function_union=len(census['confirmed_debt_owner_functions'])),
    validation=dict(commands=['.venv/bin/python configure.py', 'ninja -j 2 build/GFZE01/ok',
                              'build/tools/dtk shasum -q -c config/GFZE01/build.sha1', '.venv/bin/python tools/fzgx.py lint'],
                    returns=[int(x) for x in returns], linked_hashes=16, independent_hashes=16, lint_findings=0, local_log_sha256=sha(log)))
Path('state/repairs/bitmap-resource-layout-20261116.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print('ok', len(final), manifest['census']['categories']['marked-warning'])
